# Vo Creations

> Vo Creations is a UGC agency for AI startups and consumer apps. It builds and runs an in-house UGC program: trained creators, organic talking-head videos, and UGC ads made from what already works.

Vo Creations trains its own creators, then runs them as a brand's content team across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook. The format is talking-head storytelling, not text-on-screen templates.

## Facts

- 1B+ views generated
- 500+ trained creators
- 5M+ users converted
- 2,400+ videos produced a month on a campaign
- First posts live in 10-14 days
- 90-day minimum, then month to month
- Campaigns start at $30K/month. Creator bonuses are billed separately. No refunds.
- Founders: Thienvu Vo (Richmond, VA) and Daniel Yun (Los Angeles, CA)

## Pages

- [Home](https://vocreations.com/): positioning, results, team, how it works, FAQ
- [Case studies](https://vocreations.com/case-studies): published client studies
- [Fable](https://vocreations.com/case-studies/fable): social reading app, 10M+ organic views in 3 weeks with 3 creators (published study). Homepage card lists 25M+.
- [Cluely](https://vocreations.com/case-studies/cluely): 20M+ organic views, 20,000+ conversions, 600+ videos in 2 months
- [Maxxd](https://vocreations.com/campaigns/maxxd): fitness app, 575K+ organic views in 26 days
- [Blog](https://vocreations.com/blog): UGC insights
- [Why text-on-screen UGC fails](https://vocreations.com/blog/text-on-screen-ugc): March 2026 essay by Thienvu Vo
